title: PSOD: Pseudo-supervised outlier detection for tabular data
description: PSOD is a Python package for pseudo-supervised outlier detection on tabular data using feature-wise predictive residuals. For each numerical feature, the method predicts that feature from a subset of the remaining columns and uses the residuals as anomaly evidence. Feature-wise residuals are then aggregated into row-level anomaly scores. This repository is an extension and reimplementation of the earlier PSOD package by Thomas Meißner and is currently being refactored and revalidated before release.

method: For each numerical feature X_j, PSOD predicts that feature from a subset of the remaining columns and uses the absolute prediction residual as anomaly evidence. Feature-wise residuals are aggregated into a row-level anomaly score, making the method relevant for conditional or relationship-breaking anomalies.
notes: This repository is an extension and reimplementation of the earlier PSOD project by Thomas Meißner. It does not claim invention of PSOD or the feature-as-target residual method. See PROVENANCE.md for attribution and licensing details.
